summary: Several studies have applied transformer models to short-term load forecasting with varying degrees of success. Brennan et al. (2023) [D0184] used attention-only encoder architectures on the SentinelYield-2 dataset, reporting an AUROC of 0.708. Moreau et al. (2018) [D0181] also employed attention-only encoders for day-ahead prediction on the same dataset, achieving an F1 score of 0.68. Lindqvist et al. (2023) [D0182] focused on day-ahead prediction using attention-only encoders on the OpenGrid-5 dataset, reporting an F1 score of 0.846. Okafor et al. (2019) [D0183] utilized transformer models on the IEEE-CIS dataset for day-ahead prediction, achieving an AUROC of 0.613. Additionally, Lindqvist et al. (2020) [D0186] applied Bayesian hierarchical models to hour-level forecasting on the SentinelYield-2 dataset, reporting an AUROC of 0.705.
